execution.scope_decision: Owner authorized applying the System Design to the live ERP. Discovered a hard, deliberate constraint: css/main.css :root (the 20 D-001 tokens) is a cross-product brand contract that tests/mos-1-console pins verbatim — changing those token declarations (values OR wrapping in var()) breaks that drift test and ripples into another product. So the safe, high-value application of the System Design is the ACCESSIBILITY layer the live app was actually missing (A-016 focus, WCAG 2.4.7), which is purely additive and touches no pinned token.
execution.audit_finding: Only inputs/selects/textareas had focus styling; buttons, nav items, links and clickable cards had NO keyboard focus indicator and many controls set outline:none -> WCAG 2.4.7 Level AA failure across the whole ERP. prefers-reduced-motion (A-018) was already present and adequate — left untouched (KEEP).
